name: Feature Request

title: [FEATURE] Short description

## Description
A clear and concise description of what this feature is and why it is needed.

## Motivation
Why is this feature important? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
A high-level overview of how you'd like to see this implemented.

## Additional Context
Add any other context or references (e.g., designs, similar features in other apps) to help us understand the request.
